Each verdict was produced by an agent opening the image (and, where the crop was not interpretable alone, a render of its page). `saw` is the reason for the role; `draft` is the description. Applied by cat-harness-tools scripts/apply-image-verdicts.ts, which leaves every narrative in `draft`: only a person confirms one. First entries 2026-10-11, owner-approved (PR #7608, bean qou-v9av): the 12 documents ingested from uploads/ and the three math-PDF methodology papers, 374 images. 18 images first classed `furniture` by the inspector were re-labelled `decorative` before application: the schema assigns `furniture` only on a caller-supplied threshold basis (bean ay3x), and each is a drop shadow, blurred text-shadow copy or blank sliver carrying no information.
